source: code.claude.com/docs/en/goal re-fetched at build time 2026-08-27 and reconciled against the accepted M0-T102 snapshot (project-control/reports/M0-T102-docs-snapshot/goal.md, fetched 2026-08-26)

drift_vs_m0_t102_snapshot.note: no substantive drift: verdicts, warning frame, four clearing classes and the host-managed-credentials nuance, transient-stays-active, no-progress goal-stays-set, resume counter-reset semantics, check-in cadence/env/caps, 4000-char ceiling, trust/availability rules, and non-interactive behavior all identical

verdict_semantics.not_yet_met: Claude keeps working; the reason is guidance for the next turn
verdict_semantics.met: goal cleared; achieved entry recorded in the transcript
verdict_semantics.impossible: goal cleared; failed entry + reason recorded; no user clear needed

unrecoverable_clearing.warning_prefix: Goal cleared after an unrecoverable error

classes.auth_failure: authentication failure when Claude Code manages its own credentials; when a HOST manages them (desktop app, VS Code extension, cloud session) the goal STAYS ACTIVE because the host restores access
classes.context_overflow: a context overflow that auto-compaction couldn't clear

unrecoverable_clearing.transient_stays_active: after any other failure, including rate limits and overloaded servers, the goal stays active

no_progress: no tool use for several turns in a row -> Claude Code stops the loop, prints a warning, returns control WITH THE GOAL STILL SET; evaluation resumes after the next prompt (exact warning text undocumented - classification must be structural, never text-guessed)

resume.before_that: restored on every route EXCEPT the claude --resume picker

checkins.backoff: doubles after the first check-in, capped at four times the first interval (default: 1h after the first, then every 2h)
checkins.background_defers_evaluation: evaluation skipped while a subagent or background shell runs; evaluated at the next turn that ends with no background work
checkins.pre_2_1_239_note: before 2.1.239 only idle check-ins backed off; a turn-end check-in recurred at the first interval (snapshot line 143) - not modeled here, outside the 2.1.246+ operational range (G4 round-1 A3 completeness note)

availability.trust_rule: same workspace trust rule as hooks in settings files (evaluator is part of the hooks system)

non_interactive: claude -p "/goal <condition>" runs the loop to completion; add --output-format stream-json --verbose to see messages; Ctrl+C interrupts

evaluator.env_var_warning: read everywhere the small fast model is used, not only /goal
evaluator.no_tools: judges only what the worker surfaced in the conversation

upgrade_path: measured-live verdict/check-in captures are the owner-gated C1 canary (R192/R197); this record is documentation-confidence until then, exactly as the unit-D catalog fixture was
